title: Dimension drops by one modulo a nonzerodivisor of the maximal ideal
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring and $x\in\mathfrak m$ a nonzerodivisor of $R$. Then $\dim(R/xR)+1=\dim R$ (Krull dimensions).
